description: This PHP class 'Configuration' within the AWS SDK project manages the 'use fips endpoint' configuration setting for AWS endpoints, providing mechanisms to initialize, validate, and output this configuration value.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Handles the 'use fips endpoint' configuration setting for AWS endpoints, allowing initialization, validation, and conversion to array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the configuration with a boolean value indicating whether to use FIPS endpoints, throwing an exception if the value is invalid.

methods.name: isUseFipsEndpoint
methods.description: Returns whether FIPS endpoints are enabled based on the configuration.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Outputs the configuration as an associative array.
